meta.definition: probability that the std10 deceleration area per minute in the next 30 minutes is in the top quarter of all minutes (>= 553 bpm*s per minute)
meta.model: XGBoost binary:logistic, depth 3, 200 trees, eta 0.05, per-minute rows; label per minute (next-30-min window)
meta.features: 38 webapp non-deceleration features + 12 per-minute deceleration features computed from the std10 detector (s10_n30, s10_area30, s10_maxdepth30, s10_meandur30, s10_timefrac30, s10_n60, s10_area60, s10_ncum_per10, s10_areacum_per_min, s10_nprol_cum, s10_maxdepth_cum, s10_min_since_last)
meta.decels: std10 detector (NICHD standard baseline + rules): the same events the label and the deceleration inputs are computed from
